message_text: The course catalog page keeps crashing on my phone
I'm sorry about that. Our mobile site is being updated. Could you try using a desktop browser or clearing your mobile browser cache?
I shouldn't have to use a desktop to browse a website in 2026. This is terrible UX.
You're absolutely right, and I apologize for the inconvenience. Our web team is working on the mobile responsiveness. Can I help you find what you were looking for in the catalog?
I was trying to look up the class schedule for next semester.
The Spring class schedule is available at university.edu/schedule. Here's a direct link that should work better on mobile.
